typical_company_profile.structure: Owner. Sales manager (beats/routes). Warehouse supervisor. 5-20 delivery staff. 2-4 purchase staff. Accounts in Tally.
typical_company_profile.location: Single or multi-branch distribution hub serving retailers, kirana, and modern trade.

item_structure.approach: One Item per SKU (brand + pack size). Variants only when size/flavour share one product family.
item_structure.custom_fields_required: MRP, PTR, shelf life days, HSN code

warehouse_setup.warehouse_logic: FEFO picking requires visible batch/expiry in ERPNext. Near-expiry stock segregated before dispatch.

questions_to_ask.question: Do you sell on fixed beat/route schedules with van stock, or mainly from a central warehouse against phone orders?
questions_to_ask.purpose: Decides whether Delivery Note + van warehouse logic is Day-1 or deferred.
options: Mostly central warehouse against phone or WhatsApp orders
Mix of both — routes plus warehouse fulfillment

questions_to_ask.question: How do you handle near-expiry stock today — discounts, returns to company, or write-offs?
questions_to_ask.purpose: Sets whether Batch + FEFO + near-expiry warehouse are Day-1.

questions_to_ask.question: Do you need separate pricing by customer type (retailer vs wholesaler vs modern trade)?
questions_to_ask.purpose: Price List complexity — may stay Phase 2 for small distributors.
options: Yes — different price lists by customer type
Mostly one price with occasional discounts

questions_to_ask.question: How many branches or godowns hold sellable stock?
questions_to_ask.purpose: Multi-warehouse visibility is core for distributors with >1 location.

common_data_gaps: No batch/expiry on fast-moving SKUs — leads to FEFO failures and customer returns.
Beat/route not mapped to Customer territory — dispatch planning stays in Excel.
Opening stock without batch numbers — cannot run FEFO until physical count assigns batches.

common_failures.failure: Treating distributor SKUs as non-batch items when manufacturer prints expiry.
common_failures.why_it_fails: Near-expiry write-offs are invisible until too late; modern trade rejects deliveries.
common_failures.correct_approach: Enable Batch + expiry on all dated SKUs; FIFO/FEFO valuation.

common_failures.failure: Day-1 includes Sales Invoice when Tally remains system of record.
common_failures.why_it_fails: Double entry and GST mismatch; ops team loses trust.
common_failures.correct_approach: Day-1 = stock + dispatch trace (Delivery Note, Stock Entry); defer invoicing to Tally.

bottlenecks.primary_bottleneck: Expired or near-expiry stock not visible before dispatch.
Cannot see total stock across branches or in transit.
No systematic reorder triggers — emergency purchases at premium.
